In the unordered disjoint-support model there are 276 zero-, 792 one-, and 558 two-cells, no 3-cells. An independently rebuilt DFS found precisely 12 six-cycles and 54 eight-cycles; disjoint pairs count 30/216/171. Reconstructed 417 torus columns and the 54x54 minor from the literal published row/column indexes; its exact determinant is -1. Exact Smith forms of each torus family in this unimodular basis have ranks 30,54,54 and non-unit factors [],[2,2],[]. A separate full-boundary modular computation in the inspected source gives rank >=504, while 54 independent genuine top cycles force rank <=504; hence H2=Z^54 and the unit-minor lattice exhausts it integrally. The complete 144-automorphism orbit enumerator is explicit and deterministic. Finite computation is exhaustive for this single graph, not a theorem about a family.
